sourceChecks.text: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: The Ashtoreth URL redirects to Astarte. The page discusses ʿAštart, its plural biblical form ʿAštārōṯ, and related Israelite/Judahite worship, and separately notes “Ashteroth” in the Philistine narrative. It is relevant to the Sidonian goddess named in 2KI23:13, but it does not establish a simple one-to-one identity for that exact Biblical form; keep the relationship note qualified.
